prompt:
A horizontal strip of pixel art showing the vertical FRONT FACE of a raised wall/ledge, exactly as such faces look in a top-down JRPG map (we look straight at the face; it is the drop between an upper level and the floor). It fills the whole image edge to edge: the top 6% is the lit rim/lip of the upper surface, the face below gets gradually darker toward the bottom, and the bottom 8% is a dark contact band where it meets the floor. No floor, no sky, no objects in front. SEAMLESS horizontally (left edge continues into the right edge). The strip is about 256 x 128 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels). Material: old stone wall heavily overgrown with moss and ivy.
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
revised_prompt: Generate a single horizontal, edge-to-edge, tileable pixel-art game environment texture: the vertical FRONT FACE of a raised old stone wall/ledge in a top-down JRPG map, viewed straight onto its face (a drop from upper level to lower floor). Aspect ratio 2:1. Conceptual art grid approximately 256 x 128 square art pixels, displayed scaled up with strictly uniform large hard-edged squares. Top 6% is a narrow warm-lit stone rim/lip, immediately beneath is the wall's vertical stone face, gradually darker toward the bottom; bottom 8% is a dark contact band. The full frame contains ONLY this stone face and its narrow upper rim and lower contact band: absolutely no floor, visible top surface, horizon, sky, characters, props, or objects in front. Material is old worn uneven stone blocks with abundant moss and ivy clinging flat to masonry, leafy clumps integrated into wall. Precisely seamless horizontally: features crossing the left border continue at identical height, shape, and tone across the right border; no left/right borders, no framing. Premium hand-placed modern hi-bit 2D JRPG pixel art. Crisp consistently sized square pixels, clear clean pixel clusters of 3–10 pixels, no antialiasing, blur, soft brushes, photographic textures, random pixel noise, or checkerboard dithering. Earthy rich palette with 4–6 discrete shades per material: stone muted taupe, gray brown, and umber; moss olive and muted deep green. Hue-shift shadows toward saturated purple-red and highlights toward warm yellow. Soft even neutral lighting from upper left, calm overcast evening base colors, subtle vertical value gradient only. NO cast shadows, night treatment, lights, glow, spotlight pools, or vignette.
